narrative.overview: sCesar.dev presents the engineering work of Samuel Cesar—spanning Cloud Lakehouse Data Engineering, Predictive Machine Learning, and Autonomous Robotics (ROS 2 / YOLOv8)—as a live operational instrument rather than a decorative marketing brochure.
keyCharacteristics: Archetype: Precision Dark UI + Soft Structuralism (design_variance: 7, motion_intensity: 5, visual_density: 6).
Dual-Adaptive Polarity: Native Dark (#09090b) and WCAG 2.2 AA Light (#f8fafc) powered 100% by semantic @theme inline tokens.

Quad-Domain Semantic Encoding (Cyan + Indigo): Telemetry Cyan (#00f0ff / #0369a1) for Data Engineering & Robotics/Vision; Electric Indigo (#818cf8 / #4338ca) for Data Science/ML, Cybersecurity (Cryptography & SOC Monitoring), and Academic Distinctions.

Operational Badges vs. Certifications Architecture: Gamified and operational achievements (Bug Bounty, SOC/Pentest labs, LeetCode) render as Instrument Badges (data/badges.yaml, Hermes-ready), distinct from formal certifications.
Uniqueness Lock (U-Score >= 85/100): High-scoring custom components are frozen against structural regression.

rules.name: The Domain-Color Encoding Rule
rules.body: Never assign Cyan or Indigo arbitrarily for decoration: Cyan (--color-dominant) denotes Data Engineering, Robotics/Vision, and primary navigation/CTA focus; Indigo (--color-accent) denotes Data Science/ML and academic honors.

rules.name: The Zero-Override Light Mode Rule
rules.body: Never write [data-theme="light"] [class*="..."] !important selectors. All theme adaptation happens exclusively through CSS custom properties mapped in @theme inline.

rules.name: The Two-Line Headline Rule
rules.body: Every h1–h3 must fit in two lines or fewer at every viewport (1440px, 768px, 390px) with text-wrap: balance.

rules.name: The Monospace Discipline Rule
rules.body: Reserve Fragment Mono strictly for literal technical tokens, stack badges, complexity formulas, and quantitative metrics.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: Never apply resting drop shadows or colored neon glows to cards, buttons, or text. Depth is communicated by surface luminance steps.

dos: Do preserve all Tier S (U-Score >= 85/100) components (ProjectCardVisual.tsx, ProjectsList.tsx, HeaderNav.tsx, ImageCarousel.tsx, src/styles/global.css token engine, and /data/*.yaml SSOT endpoints) without altering their interactive mechanics.
Do use semantic Tailwind v4 classes (bg-canvas, bg-surface, bg-surface-alt, text-ink, text-dominant-ink, text-accent-ink, border-edge) for every new or refactored UI element.
Do use explicit transition properties (transition-colors, transition-transform, transition-opacity) and respect @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce).
Do ensure every <video> carries a valid poster attribute and every interactive control meets >= 36px (44px primary) touch target height.
donts: Don't hardcode domain data in .tsx/.astro components or src/i18n/translations.ts—all domain truth lives in /data/*.yaml.
Don't render empty placeholder sections on the live page when a collection is empty (such as certifications.yaml when items: []); fold or conditionally suppress empty sections.
Don't use transition-all, decorative 01 / 02 / 03 (CH // 01) index numbering on non-ordered items, tiny uppercase tracked monospace eyebrows (micro-label), or 100vh (h-screen, use min-h-dvh).
Don't use banned generic fonts (Inter, Roboto, Arial, Space Grotesk) or introduce a third competing brand color beyond Cyan and Indigo.
